item.text:
Updated [schema.sql](/private/var/folders/vv/rc3f4h3505jfy6qnq3w7m93w0000gn/T/harness-eval-Oxx1Aj/workspace/schema.sql) to protect invoice audit records and allow the demo-account purge through a dedicated non-login owner. The purge checks for unhandled restrictive foreign keys before deleting data and leaves real accounts and their audits intact.

The schema loaded on PostgreSQL 18. Checks passed for order completion, app-role audit deletion denial after setting a custom variable, preservation of real-account audits, the restrictive foreign-key diagnostic, and demo-account cleanup.

The final preflight adjustment narrows the check to delete behavior; that one-line change was not rerun. The change is ready for review, with that verification limitation.
